title: Dependency Rotations & Readiness Gates for Initiative Windows
creator: Lena Morrison
description: Background: As we prepare the Q3 initiative windows (hosted API scale, Dedicated rollout improvements, and Private deploy checklist), cross-team dependencies have repeatedly created last-minute scope changes and release churn. Current signals: missed preflight checks, unclear ownership for infra migrations, and uneven readiness from Design for console rollout. This ticket creates a lightweight operational pattern: rotating dependency 'on-call' ownership per initiative window, and a small set of readiness gates (tech, design, security, infra) that must be independently validated before a gated milestone. The goal is to reduce last-minute blockers, create clear handoffs, and provide a single source of truth for go/no-go decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A published dependency rotation roster exists for the next three initiative windows and has been reviewed by Eng, Design, Security, and Infra leads.
Readiness gate checklist is implemented as a templated Google Sheet + a tracked Dashboard row that surfaces pass/fail for each gate, and all gates map to an owner.
Two pilot initiatives (one platform, one product) run the process and the postmortem shows a >30% reduction in blocked milestone tasks caused by cross-team dependencies.
Rollout docs and playbook are approved in Confluence and linked from the Console roadmaps page.
Automation: at least one gate (security review completeness) is surfaced by query to our ticket system and triggers an escalation if past-due.
success_metrics: % of gated milestones completed without last-week dependency escalations >= 80%
Average days of schedule slip attributable to cross-team dependencies reduced by 40% vs prior quarter
Number of dependency-driven emergencies (SEV or P1) in pilot initiatives reduced to 0 during the window
work_items: Draft rotation cadence and owner responsibilities (rotate every initiative window; 2-week overlap handoff)
Define minimal readiness gate checklist per discipline (tech, design, security, infra, docs)
Build Google Sheet template + initial Dashboard view in Console -> Roadmaps
Integrate gate status with ticket queries (security review completeness, infra migration tickets linked)
Run kickoff with participating initiative PMs and leads; identify pilots
Execute two pilots; collect readiness checklist snapshots weekly
Run post-pilot retro and finalize playbook; publish Confluence doc and update roadmap process
